title: Handle output truncation in whole-document suggestions
description:
## Dogfood reproduction

A live `suggest_rewrite` call against the current Anth.us article `https://anth.us/blog/commodity-receipts/` succeeded at the OpenAI API boundary but failed while parsing the model response. The source is 1,075 words / 6,097 characters. The shared Responses client hard-codes `max_output_tokens=1200`; the complete candidate JSON was truncated mid-string and raised `RuntimeError: OpenAI editorial rewrite request did not return JSON.`

## Intent

As a caller requesting a reviewable whole-document suggestion, I want Limatus to obtain a complete structured response or fail with a specific actionable truncation error, so ordinary articles do not silently turn into malformed JSON.

## Gherkin

Feature: Complete whole-document suggestion responses
  Scenario: Generate a complete candidate for a normal-length article
    Given a roughly 1,000-word draft
    When Limatus requests a document-level suggestion
    Then it provides enough response budget for the complete structured candidate
    And the result validates as JSON with candidate text and review metadata

  Scenario: Handle an incomplete model response safely
    Given an incomplete structured model response
    When Limatus receives it
    Then it retries with a safe bounded strategy or raises a specific truncation error
    And it never returns malformed or partial candidate data

## Scope

Use a configurable, bounded output budget appropriate to full-document candidates and test the incomplete-response path without relying on a live API call.

## Out of scope

Changing the user editorial workflow or auto-applying a candidate.
